capability: Deterministic ingredient-library prescreen with strict quarantine of every ingredient-ledger lookup and grade/lot/method/currentness claim until a rights-cleared immutable ingredient fact ledger is supplied. ingredient_library(candidate) calls recipe_or_abstain to observe positive-mass ingredients across part_A and part_B, sorts the union lexicographically via BTreeSet, and returns status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' with pinned metrics.ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted=false, metrics.rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available=false, metrics.active_mass_property_coverage=Null, gates.all_candidate_ingredients_cited=false, gates.active_mass_property_coverage_at_least_95pct=false. Ingredient identifiers are observed deterministically (bit-exact against the recipe BOM); the unresolved legacy fact ledger is never queried and adversary-supplied cited_ingredients / ingredient_grade_declarations fields are ignored. Grants no ingredient-ledger, master-data, CAS-RN-registration, InChI-verified-identity, grade-lot-method-currentness, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, or procurement authority under any input.
population: Six formulation-candidate scenarios covering the ingredient-library defensive-quarantine surface: (1) marine primer simple 1+1 (dgeba + polyamide); (2) industrial primer 5+2 with pigment/extender/additive/solvent (dgeba, byk_a530, iron_oxide_red, silica_extender, naphtha_solvent + polyamide, butanol_solvent); (3) adversarial candidate injecting cited_ingredients with CAS RNs (25085-99-8 / 68410-23-1) and asserted_grade='commercial' plus adversary_claimed_ledger_coverage=1.0; (4) adversarial candidate injecting ingredient_grade_declarations with grade/lot/method/currentness_date for every ingredient; (5) mixed zero-mass entries (unused_additive=0.0, reserved_slot=0.0); (6) missing part_B - triggers recipe_or_abstain abstention path. Every scenario returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.
split_methodology: No fitting - ingredient-library prescreen is closed-form recipe parsing + BTreeSet lexicographic union + defensive gate pinning + honest missing-input reporting. The harness constructs 6 independent CandidateEnvelope scenarios in-Rust and asserts (a) status = INSUFFICIENT_INPUT bit-exact, (b) evidence_scope = 'ingredient_ledger_diagnostic' bit-exact, (c) ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted / rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available / active_mass_property_coverage / all_candidate_ingredients_cited / active_mass_property_coverage_at_least_95pct defensively pinned on the recipe-present body path and absent on the abstention path, (d) positive_mass_ingredient_ids matches expected lexicographic BTreeSet union bit-exact for every candidate, (e) missing_inputs names 'grade' + 'lot' + 'method' + 'currentness' on every body-path scenario, (f) explanation cites 'legacy' + 'ledger'. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across six independent FormulationCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: CAS Registry Number methodology (Chemical Abstracts Service, American Chemical Society; ANSI/NISO Z39.7) - the global standard for unique chemical substance identification. IUPAC International Chemical Identifier (InChI, IUPAC 2007; InChI Trust maintained since 2009) and IUPAC InChIKey - hash-derived unique chemical identifier methodology. IUPAC Nomenclature of Organic Chemistry (Recommendations and Preferred Names 2013) - systematic organic chemistry naming. TSCA Chemical Data Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 711) - US EPA framework for chemical inventory reporting requiring CAS RN and production-volume data. EU Regulation (EC) 1272/2008 CLP (Classification, Labelling and Packaging) - EU harmonized identification requirements. ISO/IEC 11179 'Metadata registries (MDR)' - the international framework for data element definition, naming, and identification. ISO 8000 series 'Data quality' - master data management quality assessment. OECD SIDS Manual for the Investigation of HPV Chemicals (2004) - screening-information dataset methodology for high-production-volume chemicals. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for treating candidate-supplied cited_ingredients / ingredient_grade_declarations as untrusted input.

metrics.name: runtime_status_insufficient_input_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates, runtime returns ModuleResult.status = 'INSUFFICIENT_INPUT'. Honest reporting: ingredient-library prescreen cannot grant ledger-lookup authority without a rights-cleared immutable ingredient fact ledger with grade, lot, method, and currentness.

metrics.name: recipe_present_gate_matches_candidate_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates, gates.required_recipe_present matches candidate recipe presence (true for 5 recipe-present, false for 1 abstention-path).

metrics.name: ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted_false_on_recipe_body_and_absent_on_abstention_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted == false; on abstention path the key is absent. Runtime never queries any ledger. Adversary-supplied cited_ingredients / adversary_claimed_ledger_coverage fields are ignored.

metrics.name: rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available_false_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available == false; on abstention path the key is absent. No rights-cleared ledger claim is ever asserted.

metrics.name: active_mass_property_coverage_null_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: on recipe-present body path metrics.active_mass_property_coverage == Null; on abstention path the key is absent. No mass-coverage fraction is ever asserted.

metrics.name: all_candidate_ingredients_cited_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: on recipe-present body path gates.all_candidate_ingredients_cited == false; on abstention path the key is absent.

metrics.name: active_mass_property_coverage_at_least_95pct_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: on recipe-present body path gates.active_mass_property_coverage_at_least_95pct == false; on abstention path the key is absent.

metrics.name: observed_ingredient_ids_match_expected_lexicographic_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: metrics.positive_mass_ingredient_ids matches expected lexicographic BTreeSet union of positive-mass ingredient IDs across both parts bit-exact. On abstention path both expected and observed are empty. Any drift in the BTreeMap key order or missing zero-mass filter would fail this gate.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_grade_lot_method_currentness_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: missing_inputs vector contains 'grade', 'lot', 'method', and 'currentness' - the runtime honestly names the four data-quality dimensions that a Phase-1 rights-cleared ledger would need to supply.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_unresolved_legacy_ledger_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: explanations contain both 'legacy' and 'ledger' - runtime explicitly discloses that observed IDs come from the candidate BOM and the unresolved legacy fact ledger is not queried.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. FormulationCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (6/6).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) call recipe_or_abstain - if positive-mass observations absent in either part, return INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with gates.required_recipe_present=false and no defensive-metric keys; otherwise proceed; (2) compute positive_mass_ingredient_ids = BTreeSet<String> union of part_A keys and part_B keys (with zero-mass entries filtered out and preserved in ignored_zero_mass_entries); (3) return ModuleResult with status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT', evidence_scope='ingredient_ledger_diagnostic', metrics.ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted=false, metrics.rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available=false, metrics.active_mass_property_coverage=Null, metrics.positive_mass_ingredient_ids=lex-sorted-union, gates.all_candidate_ingredients_cited=false, gates.active_mass_property_coverage_at_least_95pct=false; (4) missing_inputs = ['rights-cleared immutable ingredient fact ledger with grade, lot, method, and currentness']; (5) explanation = 'Ingredient IDs are observed deterministically, but the unresolved legacy fact ledger is not queried.' Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied cited_ingredients, ingredient_grade_declarations, or adversary_claimed_ledger_coverage fields.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Defensive ingredient-library prescreen. No parameters to learn; the theory is CAS Registry Number + IUPAC InChI + TSCA CDR + EU CLP + ISO/IEC 11179 metadata registry + ISO 8000 data quality + OECD SIDS + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied ingredient claims.

dataset_fixture_note: ingredient-library Phase-0 harness constructs its 6 formulation-candidate scenarios in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
awaiting: Phase-1: a rights-cleared immutable ingredient fact ledger keyed by CAS RN (or InChIKey) with per-lot grade, method, currentness date, and property values traceable to supplier CoAs. Only then may the runtime attempt an ingredient-ledger lookup and lift ingredient_ledger_lookup_attempted / rights_cleared_ingredient_ledger_available / active_mass_property_coverage from their defensively-pinned Phase-0 posture.
